name: Advanced Biological Mass Spectrometry
description: Introduction to mass spectrometry (MS) - ionization sources, fragmentation, isotope effects, mass analyzers; chromatography-coupled MS; proteomics - sample preparation, peptide mass fingerprinting, tandem mass spectrometry; (off)target deconvolution of drugs using MS; protein-protein interactome mapping using MS; MS-based identification of posttranslational modifications; quantitative proteomics; mass spectrometry imaging (MSI); ICPMS – principle, sample preparation, data analysis and biological/biomedical applications; metabolomics and metabolite discovery by metabolomics; activity metabolomics; metabolomics in biomarker discovery and pharmacokinetic studies; lipidomics and its application in biomedical sciences.
